title: D\'ej\`a Cue: Localizing States in Object Histories via Vocabulary-Relative Coordinates
abstract: arXiv:2608.02044v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Object tracking preserves identity through visual changes, but cannot tell when an object is whole, cut, or peeled. We study state-moment retrieval: locating when a tracked object exhibits each state in a supplied set of descriptions. However, absolute image--text similarity can favor shared object semantics, obscuring the distinctions needed to localize individual states. Our insight is that the alternatives themselves provide a reference for measuring state evidence. We introduce D\'ej\`a Cue, a training-free framework that centers description embeddings on a state-balanced vocabulary mean, producing query directions that compare each state against its alternatives. Using frozen vision--language encoders, D\'ej\`a Cue calibrates frame scores and retrieves intervals at multiple durations within contiguous visible runs. We construct MS-VOST by annotating 620 object histories with 2,465 states. With the encoder and temporal sear

translated_title: Déjà Cue：通过词汇相对坐标在物体追踪历史中定位状态
translated_abstract: 物体追踪能够在视觉变化中保持目标的身份一致性，但无法判断物体何时是完整的、被切开的或被削皮的。我们研究“状态时刻检索”问题：定位被追踪物体展现出给定描述集合中每个状态的具体时刻。然而，绝对的图文相似度往往偏向于共享的物体语义，从而掩盖了定位单个状态所需的区分性信息。我们的核心洞察是：备选状态本身可以作为衡量状态证据的参照基准。我们提出 Déjà Cue，一个无需训练的框架，它将描述嵌入以状态平衡的词汇均值为中心进行标准化，从而生成将每个状态与其备选项进行对比的查询方向。借助冻结的视觉-语言编码器，Déjà Cue 对帧级分数进行校准，并在连续可见片段内检索多个时长的状态区间。我们通过为620条物体历史标注2,465个状态构建了 MS-VOST 数据集。利用该编码器与时间检索（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的 Déjà Cue 框架，通过将状态描述嵌入以状态平衡的词汇均值为中心化来构造词汇相对坐标，使每个状态与其备选项进行对比，从而在物体追踪历史中精确定位状态发生的时刻，并构建了包含620条物体历史、2,465个状态标注的 MS-VOST 基准数据集。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Déjà Cue, a training-free framework that localizes object states in tracking histories by centering description embeddings on a state-balanced vocabulary mean to compare each state against its alternatives using frozen vision-language encoders, along with the MS-VOST benchmark of 620 object histories annotated with 2,465 states.
